title: ReuF2F: Benchmarking Coding Agents on Formalized Undergraduate Research Problems
abstract: arXiv:2610.27046v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As AI systems begin to resolve open research problems, reliable verification becomes increasingly important. Formal mathematics provides a trusted framework for mathematical reasoning, enabling agents to produce machine-checkable proofs while conducting mathematical exploration. Existing formal mathematics benchmarks often focus on known results or a small set of prominent open problems, which can become difficult to evaluate reliably once solutions are discovered and widely disseminated. Existing evaluation protocols are also not always aligned with how modern coding agents operate. We therefore introduce ReuF2F, a Lean 4 benchmark of 244 formalized open problems drawn from Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), spanning entry-level open research problems across a broad range of mathematical subfields. translated_title: ReuF2F：基于形式化本科研究问题的编码智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 随着人工智能系统开始解决开放性研究问题，可靠的验证变得日益重要。形式化数学为数学推理提供了一个可信的框架，使智能体在进行数学探索的同时能够生成机器可检验的证明。现有的形式化数学基准测试通常集中于已知结果或少数著名的开放问题，一旦这些问题的解被发现并广泛传播，就难以再对其进行可靠评估。此外，现有的评估协议也并不总是与现代编码智能体的工作方式相匹配。因此，我们提出了 ReuF2F，这是一个基于 Lean 4 的基准测试，包含从本科生研究经验计划（Research Experiences for Undergraduates, REU）中提取的 244 个形式化开放问题，涵盖了广泛数学子领域中的入门级开放研究问题。我们预计这些较少受到关注的开放问题——它们往往吸引的注意力较少，并可能长时间未被解决——将更……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了 ReuF2F，一个基于 Lean 4 的基准测试，包含 244 个源自本科生研究经验计划（REU）的形式化开放研究问题，用以更可靠地评估编码智能体解决开放数学问题的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ReuF2F, a Lean 4 benchmark of 244 formalized open problems drawn from Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), designed to more reliably evaluate coding agents on open mathematical research problems.
